title: Investigation of wound healing with ELEXOH mouth rinse
summary: The impact of daily oral rinsing with different mouthwashes on the healing of the wounds after tooth extraction will be investigated.

interventions.name:
Sodium cloride rinsing
The oral rinse is taken twice daily. All samples are divided in daily portions (1 bottle/day). One half in the morning the other half in the evening. Sodium chloride acts as placebo.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients requiring extraction of one or more premolars or molars
Patients with or without gingivitis or periodontitis stage I, II, or III grade A or B
Exclusion criteria:
Tumor diseases
Patients with diabetes mellitus
Patients requiring front teeth extraction
Patients requiring (partially) impacted wisdom teeth extraction
Smokers (≥5 cigarettes/day), pipe smokers
Regular drug use
Long-term immunosuppressive medication
Long-term anticoagulant medication
Need for antibiotic prophylaxis
Pregnancy
Antibiotic therapy within the last 3 months
Allergies to antiseptics, disinfectants, or antibiotics
(and/or to any of the components of the rinsing solution)
Therapy with bisphosphonates or antibodies to modulate bone metabolism
